verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is TypeScript-first: workflows are authored in TypeScript/JavaScript on Node.js and Bun through the single `@trigger.dev/sdk` module, and Python is reachable only through a build extension rather than a native SDK. That suits TypeScript teams, but it does not deliver multi-language authoring with SDK parity. Missing for 10: native Python authoring SDK, Go or other language SDKs, any evidence of feature parity across languages.
